verdict.rationale: Poke documents bearer-authenticated API keys (V1 pk_ keys and V2 keys created in Kitchen). Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped, permission-limited, or issued per agent with least privilege. Plain API keys are an adjacent control, not scoped credentials, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
